name: Dundalk Institute of Technology
summary: Institute of technology in Dundalk, between Dublin and Belfast: about 40 honours degrees via CAO, from Engineering and Computing to Nursing and Music.

ib.text: Six subjects with Maths and English (or Irish) for every honours degree; no third language. Some ask more: Mechanical Engineering Maths SL 6 or HL 4; Midwifery a lab science (2026-entry pages).

notes: Musical Theatre (DK869) selects by audition and Applied Youth Work (DK866) by interview.
Engineering has a common-entry route (DK843) alongside direct entry to Mechanical, Electrical and Electronic, and Civil Engineering.
